open_issues: Deviation from the order's literal design: the fallback condition is `document.activeElement === document.body` instead of `document.activeElement !== back`. With `!== back`, the nothing-focused case (back is body, focus stays on body) would skip the fallback and break criterion 4. Focus can only be on body here when restore failed or was not attempted, because the close button has just been removed. The existing guard is kept.
